payload.productNameEn: Morandi Color Porch Decorative Painting Nordic Style
payload.categoryName: Home, Garden & Furniture > Home Storage > Home Office Storage
payload.description:
Product information:

Material: Crystal Porcelain
Style: Nordic
Applicable space: living room
Mounting method: framed
Image format: planar
Outer frame material: aluminum alloy
Core material: oil canvas
Number of frames: single frame
Specifications: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L
Dimensions: 30 * 40cm (metal frame+canvas), 40 * 60cm (metal frame+canvas), 50 * 70cm (metal frame+canvas), 60 * 80cm (metal frame+canvas), 70 * 100cm (metal frame+canvas), 80 * 120cm (metal frame+canvas), 100 * 150cm (metal frame+canvas), 120 * 180cm (metal frame+canvas)


Packing list:

Decorative Painting*1（with frame）
